purpose: Teach: 真夜中/どっと/あげく/大金/居間/つぶやい/しつこい/うろうろ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが真夜中に帰宅されたぞ
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he'd come home in the middle of the night sometimes.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Measured pace, like sorting through old memories. Gentle weight on each phrase. Voice trails upward slightly at the end, inviting her into the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、台風で雨がどっと降ったお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and don't you remember telling me about that typhoon, how the rain came down so hard?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing affection. Participatory tone — she's not just listening, she's remembering alongside him. A gentle correction wrapped in gentleness. Soft emphasis on 'typhoon.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは苦労されたあげく、家を建てられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, he worked so hard when he was younger. In the end, he built us a house.
lines.style: Quieter now, reverent. Slower pace. The pride is understated, almost humble. Lingering slightly on 'house' — the weight of what that meant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、大金を扱うお仕事をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he did such important work with money, didn't he, dear? You were the one who managed it all.
lines.style: Gentle redirect, almost teasing. She's correcting the record softly — reminding him of his own role. Warm, knowing tone. Not lecturing, just remembering together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの居間が家族の集いの場だったぞ
lines.en: You know, his living room became where the whole family would gather.
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching for the right memory. Slight pause before 'living room' — seeing it in his mind's eye. Tender reverence. Voice settles with quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祈りをよくつぶやいてらしたわよね、あなた?, 本気で
lines.en: Of course — he was always murmuring prayers, wasn't he? So earnest about it, too.
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost with a smile in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'prayers' — acknowledging the faith that ran through him. Affectionate and sincere, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、商売の誘いがしつこい時もあったぞ
lines.en: There were times when people kept pestering him about business deals, you know.
lines.style: Measured, slightly protective tone. A hint of frustration at the memory — people wanting things from him. Not angry, just... tired for him, at this distance. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫さんが、うろうろされてた時の写真、覚えてる?あなた
lines.en: Do you remember that photo of our grandson wandering around the house back then? That was something.
lines.style: Gentle, almost playful now. A slight smile emerges in the voice. Softer, warmer — the memory of the grandchild brings lightness. Searching her face with affection.
